name: Synthetic Multi-Omics Benchmark Dataset for Nutritional Trait Prediction in Millets (500 Simulated Genotypes)
description: Synthetic Multi-Omics Benchmark Dataset for Nutritional Trait Prediction in Millets (500 Simulated Genotypes) Dataset Overview This repository provides a computationally generated synthetic multi-omics benchmark dataset representing 500 hypothetical millet genotypes. The dataset was developed to support exploratory research on artificial intelligence-assisted nutritional trait prediction, multi-omics data integration, and computational benchmarking in climate-resilient millet crops. The dataset is associated with the research manuscript titled “Machine Learning-Driven Multi-Omics Framework for Predicting Nutritional Traits in Climate-Resilient Millets.” Dataset Composition The dataset contains integrated information across multiple biological and environmental data layers: Genomics: 220 simulated single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) markers. Transcriptomics: 60 simulated gene-expression features. Proteomics: 30 simulated protein-abundance features. Metabolomics: 20 simulated metabolite features. Ionomics and nutritional traits: Simulated mineral concentrations and grain-quality indicators, including iron, zinc, protein content, and antioxidant measurements. Environmental variables: Simulated soil and climate-related characteristics. Phenotypic information: Simulated nutritional and agronomic characteristics associated with the hypothetical genotypes.
